How do I stop fearing death
</message>

<passage>
Take away your opinion about the things that seem to give you pain, and you stand yourself upon the surest ground. What is that self?--It is reason.--I am not reason, you say.--So be it; then let not reason pain itself, but leave any part of you which suffers to its own opinions of the pain.
</passage>

output.reason: Addresses perception of pain, not fear of death directly; no clear connection to overcoming death anxiety.
